result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The tests matching `*SalesRep*` and `*PurchaseOrder*` passed (exit code 0). I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example, and I didn't run the full suite.

In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6517), I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the subquery's `WHERE` clause. This is the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also added a sentence to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled purchase orders are left out.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
